name: Graves de Vayres

known.via: English Wikipedia "Graves de Vayres AOC" (redirects to "Graves de Vayres")

limits: For white wine, Merlot Blanc: at most 30%
rules.yield_base: 53 hl/ha for red, 55 for dry white, 50 for other white
blend: For white wine, main grapes together: at least 65%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation for red and white wine from two communes, Vayres and Arveyres, on the left bank of the Dordogne in the Entre-Deux-Mers area, though outside the Entre-Deux-Mers appellation. Reds use Merlot and Cabernets, whites use Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle.
